versions.content: The SOME/IP transformer on the server-ECU builds its header for the server response based on the header of the client's request and does in addition: • Construct the payload • Set the Message Type to RESPONSE (i.e. 0x80 ) • If the ClientServerOperation has at least one possibleError defined, place the return value of the executed ClientServerOperation into the Re- turn Code field and add 0x1F to adapt the number ranges in case the original return value was different from 0x00 .
